anklePrompt: Nyis tiendi nyime kendo duok chien
ankleSetup: Bed ka tiende ni nyime. Nyis lith tiende nyime, bang'e iywayo chien.
aquaticSetup: E pi ma ok tut, ka imiye kony, wuoth kata go tiendoni mos.
aquaticSub: Wuot kata go tiendi e pi ma ok tut.
armGameSub: Ket balloons opokre gi ting'o lwet.
armLibraryCopy: Puonj mar ting'o lwet maber nyaka malo mar gok.
armSetup: We chunyi malo onere. Nyathi ting'o lwete nyaka kama balloon nitie.
balanceGameSub: Bed motegno mondo ichok ring mag balance.
balanceLibraryCopy: Ranyisi mar timo balance gi kony maber.
balanceSetup: Ringruok duto onenre. Nyathi obed motegno ka jarit ni machiegni.
ball-throwSetup: Bed ewi therapy ball ka imiye kony. Witi kendo mak taya mayom.
ballThrowSetup: Bed e mpira mar therapy ka iyudore gi kony. Bol kendo imak mpira mayom.
beadsSetup: Mak usigi machwe kendo ket beads maduongo achiel ka achiel.
bilatSetup: Jiwo tiyo gi lwedo ariyo kaachiel — goyo makofi, mako, kata loro mpira.
bodyMoving: Ringruok maduong' mar ringruok ok okwan
breathingSetup: Nind kata bed maber. Ket lweti e ich kendo iywe mos.
breathingSub: Ywe matut mos ka lweti ni e ich.
bridgeSetup: Nind gi ng'ei, chonge ogore. Ting' nungo malo mos mondo ilos daraja.
brushSetup: Tii gi brashi mayom. Brashi bade gi tiende mos kaka therapist onyisi.
buttonsSetup: Tii gi bao mar rwako man-gi tange maduongo. Puonjri loro kod gonyogi.
catchSetup: Wit mpira mayom mos e borne mar agola. Nyathi omake gi lwete ariyo.
clapSetup: Ng'iy kamera. Goi lwete e nyim agola sa moro amora ma gima ochung' e nyim rieny.
clapSub: Goi lwete ka gima ochung' e nyim rieny.
crawlSetup: Los kama opandi maber. Jiwe nyathi mondo onyogond ochopi gima ohero.
cutSetup: Mak makasi ma ok hinyou ka ikonyi. Ng'ad ka iluwo lain machwe ma ochung' tir.
dailyPlanCopy: Tiek session achiel mar lwet, achiel mar tiende, kod achiel mar balance gi kony mar jakony.
drawSetup: Tii gi crayon e karatasi, kata lu kit gik gi lith lweti e yamo.
drawSub: Lu kido gi lith lweti e yamo.
dressSetup: Tii gi bodi mar puonjruok man gi buttons madongo kod zips.
dressSub: Puonjri kego buttons kod loro zips.
feedSetup: Ket bead matin e spoon. Nyathi oting'e ma ok opodho.
gaitLibraryCopy: Ranyisi mar wuotho gi kony kod puonj mar kawo okang'.
gaitSetup: Los yo maber maonge gimoro. Kaw okang' mos nyime gi kony.
gaitSub: Kaw okang' nyime kaluwore gi dwol mar bul.
gripSetup: Tii gi sponge mayom kata stress ball. Din, mak kuom sekond 3, bang'e we.
guidedSetup: Ket nyathi kama kamera nyalo nene, kendo luor kaka japuonj rito nyathi onyiso.
half-kneelSetup: Ket chong' achiel piny, to tiend machielo obed motegno e nyim. Kur ka imiye kony.
halfKneelSetup: Ket chok achiel piny, to ket tiend machielo tir e nyimi. Sik kamano ka iyudore gi kony.
halfKneelSub: Chok achiel piny, tiend machielo nyime.
handwritingSetup: Tii gi lith lweti kata crayon mondo iluor lain, duol kod korose.
headSetup: Kony nyathi obed. Wuok gi gima rieny mos mondo wang'e oluwo.
heel-raiseSetup: Mak rail. Chung' e lith tiendoni, kur matin, bang'e lor mos.
heelRaiseSetup: Mak chuma mar jengruok. Ting'ri e lith tiendi, sik matin, bang'e ilor piny mos.
heelRaiseSub: Ting'ri e lith tiendi, bang'e ilor piny.
horseSetup: Bed ewi bolster maduong' kata peanut ball ka tiendoni ni kochiel gi kochiel. Kur kamano ka iyiengo mos.
horseSub: Bed ewi bolster ka tiendoni ni kochiel gi kochiel, kendo ikur.
kneelingSetup: Chung' gi chonge e mkeka mayom, nungo obed ewi chonge. Sik kamano ka iyudore gi kony.
kneelingSub: Chung' tir gi chonge kendo sik motegno.
langFallbackNote: UI biro bedo gi Dho-Ingreji ka gombo mar {lang} pod iloso.
legGameSub: Din nyaka kuom sulwe mar bat manieng'.
legLibraryCopy: Puonj mar PT: chung' e tiende ma nyap, mak railing, bang'e gith tiende machielo. Jakony okony koa chien ka dwarore.
legSetup: Chung' gi tielo manyap moloyo ka imako rail. Din sulwe gi tielo machielo.
marchSetup: Mak kom mondo okonyi. Ting' chonge achiel ka achiel nyaka malo mar nungo, kaluwore gi dwol mar bul.
marchSub: Wuoth kaluwore gi dwol mar bul.
midlineSetup: Ket gik ma odhi mako loka machielo mar ringruok. Nyathi orie lwete okalo midline.
obstacleSetup: Ket gik matindo mayom e laini. Kal ewi moro ka moro ka iyudore gi kony.
oralSetup: Tii gi straw kata odunga mar bubbles. Fud mos mondo jiwo del mar dho.
oralSub: Fud bubbles kata mod pi gi straw.
pinchSetup: Ket beads/pom-poms e san. Nyathi odingi gi lith lwete maduong' kod lith moro.
pinchSub: Din gik matindo mondo gikadho ei kikombe.
playdoughSetup: Tii gi play dough mayom. Bwir, nind kendo diy gi lwete ariyo.
pnfSetup: Rie lweti piny kendo kalri e loka machielo mar ringruok, bang'e ting'e malo kendo oko.
pnfSub: Wang' lwet e yo makalo ang'wen.
proneName: Nindo e Ich ka Ijeng'ori gi Ng'ut Lwedo
proneSetup: Nind e ich. Jeng'ri gi ng'ut lwedo kendo ting' wich kod agoko.
proneSub: Ting' wich kod agoko ka inindo e ich.
puzzleSetup: Kaw kido kendo ket e bur mowinjore kode.
reachSetup: Ket nyamburko mayom e malo mar gok. Nyathi rie kode.
reachSub: Rie mondo iyud olembe e yien.
rollingSetup: Nind e mkeka. Lor ringruok mos koa e ng'ei nyaka e ich, kendo iduogi.
rollingSub: Lor ringruok koa e ng'ei nyaka e ich, kendo iduogi.
safetyNote: We ka lit nitie, wich biro, kata ol ma ok kawaida.
sensorySetup: Ik gik adek mopogore (mayom, ma rach, kod ma otimo bumbi). Nyathi omul moro ka moro.
sensorySub: Mul gik mayom, matek kod ma otimo bumbi.
shoulderSetup: Bed piny kata chung' tir. Wil goke nyime, malo, chien, kendo piny.
sidelyingSetup: Nind e bathi ka iyudore gi kony. Ti gi lwedo ariyo mondo itug gi nyagoya.
sidelyingSub: Tug gi lwedo ariyo ka inindo e bathi.
simonSetup: Jarit nyathi oluongo tije. Nyathi oluwgi mana ka Simon owacho.
sitstandSetup: Bed e kom motegno, tiende obed piny duto. Chung' malo mos, bang'e idog ibed piny.
squatSetup: Ket tiende bor marom gi goke, mak rail, gok chonge matin bang'e ichung' malo.
step-upSetup: Tii gi daraja matin man-gi rail. Nyono malo gi tiend achiel, bang'e machielo.
stepUpSetup: Ti gi kido maber piny ma nigi chuma mar jengruok. Ket tiend achiel malo, bang'e machielo.
stepUpSub: Idh malo kendo ilor piny e kido maber piny.
stretchSetup: Ywa muskul motegno mos gi kony. Mak ywayo ka ywayo kuom sekunde 15–20.
trackSetup: Kik ieng' wi. Lu gima wuotho mos gi wang' kende.
trunkSetup: Bed tir. Lok ringruok malo koracham kendo korachwich mos.
videoPlaceholder: Video mari mar ranyisi biro nyiso ka.
wall-standSetup: Chung' ka ng'egi kod dhoge tiendoni omulo kor ot. Kur ka imiye kony.
wallStandSetup: Chung' ka ng'eyi kod wich tiendi mulore gi ohinga. Sik kamano ka iyudore gi kony.
wallStandSub: Chung' tir ka ng'eyi ochomo ohinga.
